summaryZh: Wei Ying Lab研究肥胖相关代谢炎症与肝脏细胞间交流，关注细胞外囊泡、铁分布和Kupffer细胞microRNA如何影响脂肪肝、纤维化及胰岛素敏感性。研究页列出miR-690小鼠体内干预与细胞特异敲除等研究。
researchQuestions: 肝细胞与Kupffer细胞如何通过囊泡及microRNA调控代谢？
topics: 代谢炎症与胰岛素敏感性

How do Kupffer cells communicate with neighboring liver cells?

Iron deficiency enhances hepatocyte lipogenesis and insulin resistance
Division of Endocrinology & Metabolism Endocrinology & Metabolism UC San Diego School of Medicine
Wei Ying Lab Wei Ying, Ph.D Principal Investigator

Elevated secretion of iron-containing hepatocyte extracellular vesicles (EVs), which are normally cleared by Kupffer cells, accounts for hepatocyte iron deficiency and HSC iron overload in NAFLD/NASH livers.

Kupffer cells (KCs) produce endogenous miR-690 and, via exosome secretion, shuttle this miRNA to other liver cells, such as hepatocytes, recruited hepatic macrophages (RHMs), and hepatic stellate cells (HSCs).
